description: Dubernard performed the first successful double hand transplant in Lyon, France.

title: Discovery of the First Antibiotic (Penicillin)
description: Fleming discovered penicillin, the world's first antibiotic, revolutionizing the treatment of bacterial infections.

title: Discovery of the Structure of Viruses
description: Franklin and Klug determined the structure of tobacco mosaic virus, pioneering structural virology.

title: Discovery of the Cause of Malaria (Parasite)
description: Laveran discovered the malaria parasite in blood, earning a Nobel Prize and advancing tropical medicine.

title: Discovery of the Cause of Typhus
description: Nicolle discovered that body lice transmit epidemic typhus, leading to effective prevention measures.

title: Discovery of the Cause of Plague
description: Yersin and Kitasato independently discovered Yersinia pestis, the bacterium causing bubonic plague.

title: Discovery of the Cause of Zika Outbreak
description: Scientists confirmed the link between Zika virus and microcephaly during the 2015 Brazil outbreak.

title: First Use of Ether Anesthesia in Surgery
description: Morton demonstrated ether anesthesia during surgery at Massachusetts General Hospital, revolutionizing surgery.

title: First Use of Chloroform in Obstetrics
description: Simpson first used chloroform to relieve pain during childbirth, changing obstetric practice forever.

title: Discovery of the Rh Factor
description: Landsteiner and Wiener discovered the Rh factor in blood, preventing hemolytic disease of the newborn.

title: Discovery of the ABO Blood Group System
description: Landsteiner discovered the ABO blood group system, enabling safe blood transfusions and earning a Nobel Prize.

title: Discovery of the Rhesus Factor
description: The discovery of the Rh factor explained hemolytic disease and enabled preventive treatment.

title: First Successful Skin Graft
description: Thiersch developed the split-thickness skin graft technique, revolutionizing burn and wound treatment.

title: First Successful Face Transplant (Full)
description: Lantieri performed the first full face transplant, restoring a patient's entire face after severe trauma.

title: First Successful Uterus Transplant
description: Brännström performed the first successful uterus transplant, enabling a woman to give birth.

title: First Successful Penis Transplant
description: Van der Merwe performed the first successful penis transplant in South Africa.

title: First Successful Womb Transplant Birth
description: Brännström's team achieved the first birth from a transplanted womb in Sweden.

title: Discovery of the First Cancer Gene (oncogene)
description: Bishop and Varmus discovered the cellular origin of retroviral oncogenes, transforming cancer biology.

title: Discovery of Tumor Suppressor Genes
description: Knudson proposed the two-hit hypothesis for retinoblastoma, founding the field of tumor suppressor gene research.

title: Discovery of the BRCA1 Gene
description: King's team identified BRCA1, a major breast cancer susceptibility gene, revolutionizing genetic testing.

title: Discovery of the BRCA2 Gene
description: Stratton's team identified BRCA2, another major breast cancer susceptibility gene.

title: Discovery of Telomerase
description: Greider and Blackburn discovered telomerase, the enzyme that maintains chromosome ends, earning a Nobel Prize.

title: Discovery of RNA Interference
description: Fire and Mello discovered RNA interference, a mechanism for gene silencing that earned a Nobel Prize.

title: Discovery of Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells
description: Yamanaka reprogrammed adult cells into pluripotent stem cells, bypassing the need for embryonic stem cells.

title: Discovery of the First Gene Therapy Success
description: Anderson performed the first approved gene therapy on Ashanti DeSilva, treating ADA-SCID.

title: First CAR-T Cell Therapy Approval
description: The FDA approved tisagenlecleucel (Kymriah), the first CAR-T cell therapy for leukemia.

title: First CRISPR Gene Therapy Trial
description: Chinese scientists launched the first human CRISPR clinical trial, editing immune cells to fight lung cancer.

title: First Successful Gene Therapy for Blindness
description: Luxturna became the first FDA-approved gene therapy for an inherited disease (RPE65 mutation blindness).

title: First mRNA Cancer Vaccine Trial
description: Clinical trials began for personalized mRNA cancer vaccines, a revolutionary approach to oncology.

title: Discovery of the First Tumor Virus
description: Rous discovered the Rous sarcoma virus, the first known tumor virus, earning a Nobel Prize decades later.

title: Discovery of the Human Papillomavirus and Cancer
description: Zur Hausen identified HPV types 16 and 18 as causes of cervical cancer, earning a Nobel Prize.

title: Discovery of the Hepatitis B Virus
description: Blumberg discovered the hepatitis B virus and later developed the vaccine, earning a Nobel Prize.

title: Discovery of the Hepatitis C Virus
person: Harvey Alter, Michael Houghton, Charles Rice
description: The team identified HCV, leading to understanding and eventual cure of hepatitis C, earning a Nobel Prize.

title: Discovery of the HIV Virus
description: Montagnier and Gallo independently discovered HIV as the cause of AIDS.

title: Discovery of Prions
description: Prusiner discovered prions, infectious proteins causing diseases like mad cow disease, earning a Nobel Prize.

title: Discovery of the First Antiviral Drug (Acyclovir)
description: Elion and Hitchings developed acyclovir, the first effective antiviral drug, earning a Nobel Prize.

title: Discovery of the First Antiretroviral Drug (AZT)
description: AZT became the first approved drug for HIV/AIDS treatment, though it had been synthesized earlier for cancer.

title: Discovery of Protease Inhibitors for HIV
description: Protease inhibitors revolutionized HIV treatment, turning AIDS from a death sentence into a manageable condition.

title: Discovery of the First HAART Regimen
description: Highly active antiretroviral therapy (HAART) transformed HIV treatment by combining multiple drugs.

title: Discovery of the First Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP)
description: Truvada was approved as PrEP, a daily pill to prevent HIV infection in high-risk individuals.

title: Discovery of the First HIV Cure (Timothy Ray Brown)
description: Brown became the first person cured of HIV after a stem cell transplant from a CCR5-delta32 donor.

title: Discovery of the Second HIV Cure (Adam Castillejo)
description: Castillejo became the second person cured of HIV, also via a CCR5-delta32 stem cell transplant.

title: Discovery of the Third HIV Cure
description: A third patient was reported cured of HIV after a stem cell transplant, giving hope for future cures.

title: First Successful Cochlear Implant
description: Clark performed the first multi-channel cochlear implant, restoring hearing to the profoundly deaf.

title: First Successful Artificial Heart (Temporary)
description: Cooley implanted the first temporary total artificial heart, keeping a patient alive until transplant.

title: First Successful Permanent Artificial Heart
description: Jarvik's artificial heart was implanted in Barney Clark, the first permanent artificial heart recipient.

title: First Successful LVAD Implant
description: DeBakey implanted the first left ventricular assist device (LVAD), a bridge to heart transplantation.

title: First Successful Heart Transplant (Infant)
description: Bailey transplanted a baboon heart into Baby Fae, pioneering xenotransplantation (though she lived only 21 days).

title: First Successful Islet Cell Transplant
description: Shapiro's Edmonton Protocol enabled insulin independence in Type 1 diabetes patients through islet transplantation.

title: First Successful Face Transplant (Partial)
description: Devauchelle performed the first partial face transplant in Amiens, France.

title: First Successful Full Face Transplant
description: Barret performed the first full face transplant on a man who had shot himself in the face.

title: First Successful Penis Transplant (South Africa)
description: Van der Merwe performed the first successful penis transplant in South Africa on a circumcision victim.

title: First Successful Uterus Transplant Birth
description: Brännström's team achieved the first birth from a transplanted womb in Sweden.

title: First Successful Trachea Transplant
description: Macchiarini performed the first tissue-engineered trachea transplant, though later controversies emerged.

title: First Successful Larynx Transplant
description: Strome performed the first successful larynx transplant, restoring a patient's voice.

title: First Successful Tongue Transplant
description: Schmelzle performed the first successful tongue transplant in Germany.

title: First Successful Ovary Transplant
description: Silber performed the first successful whole ovary transplant, restoring fertility.

title: First Successful Penile Transplant (USA)
description: Johns Hopkins surgeons performed the first total penis and scrotum transplant in a U.S. veteran.

title: First Successful Womb Transplant from Deceased Donor
description: Ejzenberg's team achieved the first birth from a uterus transplanted from a deceased donor.

title: First Successful In Utero Fetal Surgery
description: Harrison performed the first successful open fetal surgery, treating congenital defects before birth.

title: First Successful Gene Editing in Human Embryos
description: Chinese scientists first reported CRISPR gene editing in human embryos, sparking global ethical debate.

title: First Successful 3D-Printed Organ Transplant
description: Researchers transplanted 3D-printed bone, muscle, and cartilage structures into animals.

title: First Successful Brain-Computer Interface (Human)
description: Kennedy implanted the first human brain-computer interface, allowing a locked-in patient to communicate.

title: First Successful Deep Brain Stimulation
description: Benabid developed deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's disease, revolutionizing movement disorder treatment.

title: First Successful Vagus Nerve Stimulation
description: VNS was approved for epilepsy treatment, using electrical pulses to prevent seizures.

title: First Successful Spinal Cord Stimulation
description: Shealy developed spinal cord stimulation for chronic pain management.

title: First Successful Bionic Eye (Argus II)
description: The Argus II retinal prosthesis was approved, restoring limited vision to retinitis pigmentosa patients.

title: First Successful Exoskeleton for Paralysis
description: The FDA approved the Ekso exoskeleton, enabling paraplegics to stand and walk.

title: First Successful Robotic Surgery (Heart)
description: Chitwood performed the first robotic mitral valve repair using the da Vinci surgical system.

title: First Successful Remote Surgery (Lindbergh Operation)
description: Marescaux performed the first transatlantic telesurgery, removing a gallbladder from a patient in Strasbourg while in New York.

title: First Successful Hand Transplant (USA)
description: Breidenbach performed the first hand transplant in the United States at Jewish Hospital in Louisville.

title: First Successful Abdominal Wall Transplant
description: Rubio performed the first successful abdominal wall transplant in Spain.

title: First Successful Composite Tissue Allotransplantation
description: The first successful hand transplant launched the field of composite tissue allotransplantation.

title: First Successful Nerve Transfer Surgery
description: Mackinnon pioneered nerve transfer surgery, restoring function to paralyzed limbs by rewiring nerves.

title: First Successful Microsurgical Replantation
description: Malt reattached the severed arm of a 12-year-old boy, the first successful limb replantation.

title: First Successful Toe-to-Hand Transfer
description: Buncke performed the first microsurgical toe-to-hand transfer, restoring thumb function.

title: First Successful Jaw Transplant
description: Genden performed the first successful jaw transplant, including the tongue and teeth.

title: First Successful Skull and Scalp Transplant
description: Rodriguez performed the first skull and scalp transplant on a burn victim.

title: First Successful Penis Transplant (China)
description: Hu performed the first penis transplant in China, though it was later removed due to psychological issues.

title: First Successful Uterus Transplant (Turkey)
description: Ozkan performed the first uterus transplant from a deceased donor in Turkey.

title: First Successful Ovarian Tissue Transplant
description: Oktay performed the first ovarian tissue transplant, restoring fertility after cancer treatment.

title: First Successful Testicular Tissue Transplant
description: Brinster developed techniques for testicular tissue transplantation and spermatogonial stem cell preservation.

title: First Successful Fecal Microbiota Transplant
description: Eiseman used fecal enemas to treat pseudomembranous colitis, pioneering fecal microbiota transplantation.

title: First Successful Fecal Transplant (Modern Protocol)
description: Khoruts performed the first modern fecal microbiota transplant using colonoscopy, curing C. difficile infection.

title: First Successful Phage Therapy (Modern Era)
description: Modern phage therapy was revived to treat antibiotic-resistant bacterial infections.

title: First Successful Bacteriophage Therapy
description: D'Herelle used bacteriophages to treat dysentery, pioneering phage therapy.

title: First Successful Antibiotic (Salvarsan)
description: Ehrlich developed Salvarsan, the first effective treatment for syphilis, the first modern antibiotic.

title: First Successful Sulfa Drug (Prontosil)
description: Domagk discovered Prontosil, the first commercially available antibacterial drug, earning a Nobel Prize.

title: First Successful Antihistamine
description: Bovet discovered the first antihistamine, revolutionizing allergy treatment and earning a Nobel Prize.

title: First Successful Cortisone Synthesis
description: Julian synthesized cortisone from soybeans, making the anti-inflammatory drug affordable and accessible.

title: First Successful Birth Control Pill
description: Pincus and Rock developed the first oral contraceptive, Enovid, revolutionizing women's reproductive rights.

title: First Successful In Vitro Fertilization Birth
description: Louise Brown became the first baby conceived through IVF, opening new possibilities for fertility treatment.

title: First Successful Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection
description: Palermo developed ICSI, enabling fertilization even with severely impaired sperm.

title: First Successful Preimplantation Genetic Diagnosis
description: Handyside performed the first PGD, screening embryos for genetic diseases before implantation.

title: First Successful Cloning of a Mammal (Dolly)
description: Dolly the sheep became the first mammal cloned from an adult somatic cell, using nuclear transfer.

title: First Successful Gene Therapy for Cancer
description: Rosenberg performed the first gene therapy trial for cancer, using tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes.

title: First Successful Immunotherapy for Cancer (Ipilimumab)
description: Ipilimumab was approved for melanoma, the first checkpoint inhibitor, revolutionizing cancer treatment.

title: First Successful CAR-T Cell Therapy
description: June's team developed CAR-T therapy, engineering a patient's own immune cells to attack cancer.

title: First Successful CRISPR Treatment for Sickle Cell
description: Frangoul treated the first sickle cell patient with CRISPR gene editing, producing functional red blood cells.

title: First Successful CRISPR Treatment for Beta-Thalassemia
description: Frangoul treated the first beta-thalassemia patient with CRISPR, reducing transfusion dependence.

title: First Successful mRNA Vaccine (COVID-19)
description: The first mRNA vaccines for COVID-19 were approved, demonstrating a revolutionary new vaccine platform.

title: First Successful Dengue Vaccine Approval
description: Dengvaxia became the first approved dengue vaccine, though later safety concerns emerged.

title: First Successful Ebola Vaccine Approval
description: Ervebo became the first FDA-approved Ebola vaccine, a critical tool for outbreak control.

title: First Successful Malaria Vaccine Approval (RTS,S)
description: RTS,S became the first malaria vaccine recommended by WHO for children in sub-Saharan Africa.

title: First Successful RSV Vaccine Approval
description: The first RSV vaccines for older adults were approved, decades after the field began.

title: First Successful Alzheimer's Drug (Aduhelm)
description: Aduhelm was controversially approved as the first Alzheimer's drug targeting amyloid beta, though efficacy was debated.

title: First Successful Leqembi Approval
description: Leqembi was fully approved for Alzheimer's, showing modest slowing of cognitive decline.

title: First Successful Gene Therapy for Hemophilia
description: Hemgenix was approved as the first gene therapy for hemophilia B, reducing bleeding episodes.

title: First Successful Gene Therapy for Muscular Dystrophy
description: Elevidys was approved as the first gene therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

title: First Successful Artificial Cornea (AlphaCor)
description: AlphaCor became the first artificial cornea approved for human use, restoring sight.

title: First Successful Bionic Hand (i-Limb)
description: The i-Limb became the first commercially available bionic hand with individually powered fingers.

title: First Successful Thought-Controlled Prosthetic
description: A paralyzed woman controlled a robotic arm using only her thoughts, via a brain-computer interface.

title: First Successful 3D-Printed Heart Tissue
description: Researchers 3D-printed a heart with human tissue and blood vessels, a major step toward organ printing.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Bladder Transplant
description: Atala's team transplanted the first lab-grown organ, a bladder, into patients with spina bifida.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Trachea
description: Macchiarini transplanted the first tissue-engineered trachea, though later results were controversial.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Blood Vessel
description: Niklason grew the first tissue-engineered blood vessel, a breakthrough for vascular surgery.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Skin Graft
description: Green cultured the first human skin cells for grafting, revolutionizing burn treatment.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Cornea
description: Griffith developed tissue-engineered corneas for transplantation.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Cartilage
description: Vacanti grew cartilage in the shape of a human ear on a mouse's back, demonstrating tissue engineering potential.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Heart Valve
description: Tranquillo developed tissue-engineered heart valves for pediatric patients.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Liver Tissue
description: Bhatia's team created liver tissue that could be implanted and function in mice.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Kidney Tissue
description: Ott's team bioengineered a functional rat kidney by stripping and reseeding a donor organ.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Pancreas Tissue
description: Odorico's team developed insulin-producing pancreatic tissue from stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Lung Tissue
description: Niklason's team bioengineered functional lung tissue in the lab.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Intestine
description: Grikscheit's team grew functional intestinal tissue from stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Esophagus
description: De Coppi's team bioengineered an esophagus for a child with long-gap esophageal atresia.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Urethra
description: Atala's team transplanted lab-grown urethras into patients, restoring urinary function.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Vagina
description: Atala's team transplanted lab-grown vaginal organs into patients with Mayer-Rokitansky syndrome.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Penis (Animal)
description: Atala's team bioengineered functional penile erectile tissue in rabbits.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Bone Marrow
description: Bhatia's team created functional bone marrow from human stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Lymph Node
description: Koido's team created functional lymph node-like structures for immune cell production.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Thymus
description: Blackburn's team grew a functional thymus from reprogrammed cells in mice.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Spleen Tissue
description: Koido's team developed spleen-like tissue for immune function.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Adrenal Gland
description: Yoshimura's team created adrenal tissue from stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Pituitary Gland
description: Kikuchi's team grew pituitary tissue from embryonic stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Thyroid Gland
description: Bianco's team created functional thyroid tissue from stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Parathyroid Gland
description: Kim's team bioengineered parathyroid tissue for transplantation.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Salivary Gland
description: Izumi's team created functional salivary gland tissue from stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Tear Gland
description: Kalmann's team grew tear-producing gland tissue in the lab.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Sweat Gland
description: Tsuji's team regenerated functional sweat glands from stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Hair Follicle
description: Tsuji's team regenerated fully functional hair follicles from stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Tooth
description: Tsuji's team bioengineered a tooth that erupted and functioned in a mouse.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Inner Ear Hair Cells
description: Heller's team created inner ear hair cells from stem cells, a step toward treating deafness.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Retina
description: Takahashi's team created retinal tissue from iPS cells for clinical trials.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Optic Nerve
description: Martin's team regenerated optic nerve tissue in the lab.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Spinal Cord Tissue
description: Tuszynski's team grew spinal cord tissue that could transmit signals.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Brain Tissue (Organoid)
description: Lancaster created the first cerebral organoids, mini-brains from stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Heart Muscle Patch
description: Radisic's team created a patch of functional heart muscle for repair after heart attacks.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Blood Vessels for Bypass
description: McAllister's team implanted lab-grown human acellular vessels for dialysis access.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Nerve Graft
description: Marra's team created bioengineered nerve grafts for peripheral nerve repair.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Tendon
description: Elisseeff's team created functional tendon tissue from stem cells.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Ligament
description: Laurencin's team bioengineered ligament tissue for ACL repair.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Meniscus
description: Mao's team created a 3D-printed meniscus that was successfully implanted.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Intervertebral Disc
description: Bonassar's team created functional intervertebral disc tissue.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Cartilage for Knee Repair
description: Martin's team implanted lab-grown cartilage into patients with knee defects.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Bone for Jaw Reconstruction
description: Vunjak-Novakovic's team created vascularized bone grafts for jaw reconstruction.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Skin for Burn Patients
description: Green's cultured epidermal autografts revolutionized treatment for severe burns.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Cornea for Transplant
description: Griffith developed tissue-engineered corneas for transplantation.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Conjunctiva
description: Gipson's team created conjunctival tissue for ocular surface reconstruction.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Lacrimal Duct
description: Atala's team bioengineered lacrimal ducts for tear drainage.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Trachea for Child
description: Macchiarini implanted a tissue-engineered trachea in a child, though long-term results were poor.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Bronchus
description: Macchiarini transplanted the first tissue-engineered bronchus.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Esophagus Segment
description: De Coppi's team bioengineered an esophagus for a child with long-gap esophageal atresia.

title: First Successful Lab-Grown Stomach Tissue
description: Wells' team created functional gastric tissue from stem cells.

description: Grikscheit's team grew functional intestinal tissue from stem cells.
